summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Nomadly/HostBay hosting panel. FIXED critical bug: Domain removal optimistic update was not working - UI waited for backend API response (2-3 seconds) before updating. Fixed by moving state update BEFORE the API call. MySQL Database Wizard full CRUD tested and working. All regression tests passed.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: Domain removal was NOT optimistic - UI waited for backend API response (2-3 seconds) before removing domain from list. Fixed by moving setDomains() call BEFORE the API call, with rollback on error.

issues: React hydration warnings about <span> inside <tbody>/<option>/<select> - caused by Visual Editor wrapper components (data-ve-dynamic spans). Development-only, won't affect production.

critical_code_review_comments: DomainList.js handleRemove() was labeled as 'optimistic removal' but actually waited for API response before updating UI. True optimistic UI should update state immediately and rollback on error.
MySQL CRUD operations all working correctly with proper success/error messages
All data-testid attributes are properly implemented for testing

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All features working correctly after fix

Subdomains (shop, blog, api, dev) all display correctly with 'Open →' quick-nav links. Bulk Import feature working. Original test data (nbayftest_testdb, nbayftest_testuser) preserved.

rca_of_the_issue.bug: Domain removal not updating UI immediately
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: In DomainList.js handleRemove(), the setDomains() call was placed AFTER the await api() call, meaning the UI waited for the backend response (2-3 seconds for cPanel API) before updating.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Moved setDomains() and setDocrootModes() calls BEFORE the API call. Added rollback logic to restore previous state if API fails.
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Tested with optimistictest1788116782.com - domain removed from UI in 0.146 seconds (was 2+ seconds before fix)
